_about: Generated parts (Tripo, TRELLIS, ...) as DATA. Each entry is prepared once by tools/ai_part.py (raw model -> cut, fitted, reduced, painted paper part in <prepared>/) and registered automatically by blender/character/part_registry.py as a rigid part a recipe can name. Rigid only: a generated mesh is one fused shell, so it is a hat, a head, a mask, a plate, a prop - never a body that bends. cut = keep above this fraction of the model height; fit = where the cut plane goes in the rig (bottom_z, metres), how tall the kept piece is (height, metres) and where the neck skin is centred (neck_xy); faces = facets after reduction; dark_below = sRGB luminance under which paint counts as dark (hair sheet, ink); glow = which paint glows. lantern = how much of the character's inner glow comes through each sheet (the folded mask takes 1.0; ink blocks it).
